description: World-first autonomous monitor for constitutional amendment lifecycle across ACSA + ACPA corpus. ACAM continuously tracks amendment health, detects stale proposals beyond configurable thresholds, flags section-level conflicts (including CRITICAL dual-RATIFIED collisions), computes live coverage scores, and appends all events to an HMAC-SHA-256 chained append-only monitor ledger. Operates in strict read-only mode per ACAM-SCOPE-0.
world_first_claims: First autonomous constitutional amendment lifecycle monitor operating across a heterogeneous multi-agent amendment corpus (ACSA + ACPA)
First system to automatically compute amendment section coverage scores from live HMAC-chained ledger data
First conflict detection engine for constitutional amendments with severity-tiered alerting (WARNING / CRITICAL)
First stale-proposal alerting system with configurable HUMAN-0-gated threshold reconfiguration

hard_class_invariants.description: Monitor config changes require HUMAN-0 authorization
Monitor records are immutable once appended
ACAM is read-only — never mutates constitution or proposals
Chain integrity verified on every ledger read
Amendment conflict detection fires before any RATIFIED state change
Coverage score computed from live ACSA ledger — never hardcoded
Monitor ledger write uses os.replace() for atomicity
All CRITICAL alerts appended to ledger before response is returned
